name: SKP Bearing Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, SKP Bearings Ltd manufactures & supplies Precision needle rollers, cylindrical rollers, pins and balls[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SKP BIL is an IATF-16949 certified manufacturer of precision rolling elements and pins. These rollers reduce frictional forces between two elements to facilitate the desired relative motion. It also offers customized products as per customer's specific requirements. The company has recently diversified into the power generation business with wind and solar plants

cons: Stock is trading at 6.86 times its book value
